Non-gory, no blood, no skeleton, no ghost. Natural small intermediate poses, distinct frames, entire figure visible, no text, labels, guide lines, shadows, floor or background.

baseClips.label: 숨쉬며 대기
baseClips.motion: Planted feet with a small breathing cycle: head, torso, sword arm, hips and knees move gently while both soles stay at the same floor line; return to the starting pose.

baseClips.label: 지상 대시
baseClips.motion: fast low grounded dash held loop, body nearly horizontal leaning right, bent leading knee, trailing leg extended, sword tightly behind and scarf streams left, small alternating leg motions without root travel

baseClips.label: 기본 베기 1타
baseClips.motion: one complete horizontal sword slash: neutral low sword, draw sword back left, coil torso, sword crosses front right, full rightward horizontal extension, torso follows, decelerate, finish sword extended low right; no magical slash trail

baseClips.label: 연속 베기 2타
baseClips.motion: one rising diagonal sword slash: start with sword chambered low left, knees bent, unwind torso, sword rises across chest, blade crosses above head, extend arm upward right, settle hips, end sword raised above right shoulder

baseClips.label: 연속 베기 3타
baseClips.motion: strong downward finishing slash: begin sword above head, elbow coils, lift on toes, shoulders drive down, sword cuts diagonally down right, knee compresses, blade decelerates near low right, finish deep forward follow-through

baseClips.label: 대시 베기
baseClips.motion: dashing slash in place: low dash pose sword trailing, shoulders coil, sword accelerates across front, blade extends right horizontally, low lunge, scarf follows, braking knee bends, end low sword-forward lunge; no afterimage

baseClips.label: 마법 준비
baseClips.motion: magic charge body motion only: neutral sword low in right hand, lift empty left hand, open palm right, shoulders pull back, knees brace, palm draws close to chest, look forward, hold prepared casting stance; absolutely no glow or magic effects

baseClips.label: 지상 대시 시작
baseClips.motion: dash anticipation from neutral: weight forward, front knee bends, torso lowers, rear foot pushes, sword moves behind, body leans almost horizontal, scarf whips left, end canonical low ground dash pose

baseClips.label: 마법 후 자세 회복
baseClips.motion: magic release recovery: start left palm fully extended right and right sword low, relax fingers, bend left elbow, lower hand, center shoulders, straighten knees, cloak settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

baseClips.label: 대시 공격 후 회복
baseClips.motion: dash slash recovery: start low sword-forward lunge, leading foot brakes, rear leg catches up, sword lowers, torso rises, shoulders uncoil, cloak settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle
